claims: The Artemis II mission successfully launched from Kennedy Space Center on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The SLS rocket carried four astronauts to the Moon for the first time in over 50 years.
The Artemis II launch followed a 6:24 p.m. EDT target time.
Artemis II is a NASA mission.
The launch vehicle for Artemis II is Space Launch System (SLS) with Orion spacecraft.
Artemis II launch time is 6:35 PM EDT (2235 UTC).
Artemis II launch site is LC-39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis II mission goal is a 10-day trip around the Moon.
